analysis: Both units are base_text excerpts of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (base lines 894-1575). No patch or head text was supplied, so the actual PR change is not visible. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety. The file is documentation only, so no executable security behavior changes in these units. Base content that later passes should check against the head diff and the threat model: (1) `darkbloom unenroll` documents full exit versus `--keep-serving`, with macOS 27+ App Attest migration requiring fresh coordinator removal approval and no fallback to cleanup (TB-011, T-052, T-057). (2) `darkbloom report` uploads logs and App Attest evidence. Device-wide devicecheckd observations are stripped of message text, key identifiers and paths, and tagged not_attributable_to_darkbloom. Runs under sudo read the invoking user's auth token read-only (T-058, A-015). (3) The prefix-cache / SSD cache environment variables and defaults (DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE, DISK_GB, the SSD daily write budget) and the model cache location pinning relate to T-041 / SEC-035. Any head edit that loosens the documented TTL, disk budget, default-on posture, or ambient-env cache override semantics should be checked against T-041. (4) Coordinator cache routing is stated as default off (EIGENINFERENCE_CACHE_ROUTING_MODE). (5) Fan control and the lease/IPC constants relate to TB-010 and T-044 to T-048. (6) Update verification of bundle, binary and metallib hashes relates to T-013 and T-043. Because the head side is unavailable, a pass with access to the diff should confirm that doc changes do not misstate trust or serving authorization (T-052, T-056).
